newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia's Sihanouk mourns death of Chinese leader.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia's Sihanouk mourns death of Chinese leader.

text.p: Cambodia's King Norodom Sihanouk on Thursday mourned the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, laying a wreath at the Chinese Embassy in memory of his long-time friend.

"I would like to express deeply my respectful admiration and gratitude to the soul of his excellency President Deng Xiaoping, who was a great man and respected hero of the Chinese people and nation...and a great friend of Cambodia," said Sihanouk, reading a condolence letter before Chinese Ambassador Xie Yue'e.
He told Xie Yue'e he was profoundly saddened by Deng's death, and bowed several times before an embassy memorial which read, "Comrade Deng Xiaoping lives forever."
China's official news agency reported Deng, 92, died late on Wednesday from Parkinsons disease and a lung infection.
Sihanouk considered Deng an "extremely good friend," said Foreign Minister Ung Huot.
Sihanouk lived in China during periods of turmoil in Cambodia in the 1970s and 1980s.
Ung Huot called Deng "a great man in reforming China" and said strong ties between the two nations would continue.
Sihanouk is expected to make a previously scheduled trip to Beijing for medical treatment on Monday.
